Blocking stopwords

Source: R/stopwords-tokens.R
np_stopwords.Rd

Non-discriminating legal/filler tokens dropped from name-token blocking so blocks stay small and precise. Deliberately conservative (legal forms and function words only) — rely on max_ref_freq in npmatch::np_block() to prune the remaining corpus-common words data-drivenly rather than hard-coding them.

Usage

np_stopwords()

Value

A character vector of uppercase stopwords.
